query: How does that compare to Mars?
answer:
Mars is far colder than Venus. Its average surface temperature is about −63 °C (−81 °F), which puts it roughly 525 °C below Venus's average of about 464 °C [1][2]. Temperatures on Mars also swing a lot, from about −140 °C to around 20 °C depending on the place, season and time of day [2].

Both planets have atmospheres made mostly of carbon dioxide, so the difference comes from how thick the air is. The Martian atmosphere has a surface pressure of only about 0.6% of Earth's, so it holds in very little heat [2]. Mars is also farther from the Sun. Venus's surface pressure, by comparison, is roughly 90 times Earth's, which traps heat and produces a runaway greenhouse effect.

Sources:
[1] Temperatures Across Our Solar System – NASA Science: https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/temperatures-across-our-solar-system/
[2] Atmosphere of Mars – Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atmosphere_of_Mars
